description: Tutto Enhancements: Home and Work shortcut chips with clean Back navigation, and local search suggestions: Home, Work, labels, saved places (name, note, category) and recent places above Google's suggestions, plus Home, Work and labels with an empty search box or directions stop. Use with bearinmind patches 2.10.0 and Offline saved places on Maps 26.44.06.1006895251. Do not enable a microG variant.

patches.name: Home and Work shortcuts
patches.description: Adds Home and Work shortcut chips beside Maps' category carousel, with clean Back navigation. Select alongside bearinmind's Offline saved places, which draws saved places, labels and starred places on the map. Built for bearinmind 2.10.0 and Maps 26.44.06.1006895251. Does not support the microG variants.

patches.name: Label search suggestions
patches.description: Shows your Local saved places above Maps' search suggestions: while you type, matching Home, Work and labels, saved places (by name, note or category) and recent places; with an empty search box or directions stop, Home, Work and every label. Case and accents are ignored and nothing is sent to Google. Tap one to open the place, or in directions to set the stop being edited. Select alongside bearinmind's Offline saved places. Built for bearinmind 2.10.0 and Maps 26.44.06.1006895251. Does not support the microG variants.

release_notes:
For bearinmind patches 2.10.0 and Google Maps 26.44.06.1006895251, on Morphe Manager 2.x.

**Label search suggestions** now covers all of Local saved:
- While you type: matching Home, Work and labels, saved places (by name, or by note and category) and recent places, above Google's suggestions.
- With an empty search box or directions stop: Home, Work and every label, one tap away.
- Tapping a saved or recent place opens it. In directions, it sets only the stop you are editing.

**Home and Work shortcuts** no longer disappear on a Maps build they weren't made for. If the pinned chip style can't be used, the chips are drawn from measurements of Maps' own category chip.

Maintenance: a daily check of new bearinmind releases (Maps version, the bearinmind code we call, and possibly overlapping new patches) opens an issue here when something needs attention.

Tested with Morphe Desktop 2.2.0 on the stock 26.44.06 APK (34 patches applied, 0 failed) and on an Android 16 emulator.
Use with Offline saved places. Do not enable a microG variant.
repoDescription: Reproducible Ungoogled Maps builds with Home/Work shortcuts, local map markers and searchable labels.
